doc: The gates a change must pass, grouped into lanes. A gate reports passed, failed, skipped or unavailable, and a lane with an unavailable blocking gate is partial, never passed. The project's own checks are the executables in .agents/bin/ (format, lint, build, test): a gate whose executable is not there reports unavailable and names it, so a new repository is honest about what it has not yet set up rather than green by default. Write those four for your language, or add them with `init --with <addon>`.

lanes.doc: Before every commit: cheap, and it runs on what the change touched.
Before a change is handed on: fast, and the build, the linter and the harness's own definitions.
Before a merge to the main line, and for high-risk work: focused, the whole test suite, and the secret and dependency scanners.

gates.name: no merge-conflict markers
gates.command: fs=$(for f in {{files}}; do [ -f "$f" ] && printf '%s\n' "$f"; done); [ -n "$(printf '%s' '{{files}}' | tr -d ' ')" ] || fs=$(git ls-files); [ -z "$fs" ] && exit 0; ! printf '%s\n' "$fs" | xargs grep -nE '^(<<<<<<<|>>>>>>>)( |$)' --
gates.doc: Fails when a changed file, or any tracked file if no paths are known, still holds a <<<<<<< or >>>>>>> line. It needs only git and a POSIX shell, so it runs in any repository.

gates.name: formatting
gates.doc: The project's formatter, in check mode: .agents/bin/format <files>. Exit non-zero when a file is not formatted.

gates.name: build
gates.doc: The project's build, warnings treated as errors where the language allows: .agents/bin/build.

gates.name: tests for the change
gates.doc: The project's tests for the files that changed: .agents/bin/test <files>. With no files it runs everything.

gates.name: all tests
gates.doc: The project's whole test suite: .agents/bin/test with no arguments.

gates.name: harness definitions
gates.doc: The harness's own check of .agents/: every role, workflow, gate and schema consistent with the others. It needs the harness on PATH as `noetic-harness`, the name the release installs it under.

gates.name: secret scanner
gates.doc: Credentials in the tree or its history.

gates.name: dependency scanner
gates.doc: Known vulnerabilities in the dependencies the lockfiles name.

gates.name: independent review
gates.doc: A person or a role other than the author read the change and recorded what they checked.

gates.name: human approval
gates.doc: A person approved this specific action, and the approval is recorded where the work is tracked.

gates.name: rollback stated
gates.doc: How the change is undone is written down before it is made.

gates.name: benchmark recorded
gates.doc: The candidate's result on the tasks it targets, recorded in the evolution ledger.

gates.name: holdout recorded
gates.doc: The candidate's result on tasks it was not tuned on, recorded by someone other than its author.
